title: Stage 5 screw connections
suptitle: R_hip_pitch_to_roll_roll_flip (yellow Stage 5, pitch link): land on the ST3025 wheel face, arms clamped on the roll horn / idler faces

sections.title: SECTION A-A at y 2 (pitch axis, wheel screws 1 / 4), seen from -y
SECTION B-B at z 190 (roll axis, horn / idler screws), seen from +z

body:
mass 12.40 g PAHT-CF (was 11.57) + 12 steel sleeves 4.68 g (was 4.30)
screws (stack = L - 0.5 - reference, from the defined holes):
  4 x M3x12 ISO 7380 into the ST3025 wheel: stack 8.55,
    engaged 2.935-2.95 of 2.95, tip at the hole bottom
    (land on the wheel face, hub pocket r 4.2, heads in
    dia 6.4 counterbores 1.51 deep)
  4 x M3x8 into the roll horn: stack 5.0, engaged 2.5 of 2.5
  4 x M3x8 into the roll idler: stack 5.4, engaged 2.1 of 2.1
    (arms clamp on the horn / idler face via r 12.1 discs;
     necks keep the old faces)
gaps (library / exact fit):
  H-cage plates: 1.38 mm (roll -45..25; was 1.38)
  roll case: 0.60 mm (was 0.60); Stage 6 green: 0.55 (was 0.55)
FEM (roll_flip_checks, legacy PAHT-CF dry, layer x):
  6 kg x 1.5 g: p99 24.7 MPa (was 34.0), SR 3.73 (was 2.71)
  roll stall:   p99 25.4 MPa (was 24.6), SR 3.62 (was 3.74)
press: spacer support 90.6-94.2 % per sleeve (was 90.6-94.2)
